import numpy as np
# test sketch 3x3
T=np.array([[0,4,0],[0,4,2],[3,0,2]])
# test shape blocks 6x6
ob=set([(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]+[(2,c) for c in range(2,6)]+[(3,c) for c in range(2,6)]+[(4,c) for c in range(1,5)]+[(5,c) for c in range(1,5)])
print(len(ob))
def transforms(A):
    names=['id','T','fliplr','flipud','flipboth','ccw','180','cw']
    arrs=[A,A.T,A[:,::-1],A[::-1,:],A[::-1,::-1],np.rot90(A),np.rot90(A,2),np.rot90(A,-1)]
    return zip(names,arrs)
for name,A in transforms(T):
    n=A.shape[0]; s=6//n
    B=np.kron(A,np.ones((s,s),int))
    cov=[(r,c,B[r,c]) for (r,c) in ob if B[r,c]!=0]
    extra=[(r,c,B[r,c]) for r in range(6) for c in range(6) if B[r,c]!=0 and (r,c) not in ob]
    print(name, "covered",len(cov),"extra",len(extra), extra)
